purpose: Qibla screen design proposals for selection before implementation

concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE high-fidelity, buildable mobile app screen design proposal for Halovat, an existing Uzbek prayer app. Portrait 9:19.5 proportion, full screen flat screenshot, no phone hardware frame, no hands, no presentation collage, no external labels or watermark. Crisp readable iOS system typography and carefully spaced real UI, not a poster. App palette warm ivory #FAF9F5, dark emerald #064E3B, mint #BFF1DB and #77D3AF, black ink. Restrained contemporary iOS controls; avoid excessive glass pills, gradients everywhere, multiple generic dashboard cards, unnecessary features or ornamental Islamic patterns.
Keep these real features only: top screen title "Qibla"; small location row "Toshkent" with "GPS · ±17 m" and a subtle edit/location icon; main Qibla directional display; a clear actionable instruction "O‘ngga 52° buring"; secondary readings "Qibla 240°" and "Telefon 188°"; small outlined recalibration action "Qayta sozlash"; nearby mosques action "Yaqin masjidlar" near the bottom. No profile icon. No mosque list or map.
Always include an elegant native-looking persistent bottom tab bar with FIVE small outline icons and labels, in this exact left-to-right order: "Bosh sahifa", "Namozlar", "Tasbeh", "Qibla", "Profil". Fourth tab is selected emerald, others neutral. Include subtle realistic status bar at top and safe area below navbar.
Kaaba artwork must look recognizably like the real Kaaba: black cuboid with broad gold embroidered band near top, thin gold ornament, golden door on one face, slight isometric angle, matte textile and realistic highlights; no domes, roofs or mosque minarets. 3D asset should be beautifully crafted and physically plausible. Qibla alignment instrument is NOT a geographic map: a fixed target at top marks direction to align the phone with; the directional pointer is 52 degrees CLOCKWISE from top indicating the user should turn right. No inaccurate compass cardinal labels. All elements comfortably fit one screen without scrolling. Preserve visual hierarchy and airy but purposeful space.
DIRECTION 1: "Ivory precision". Bright, tactile, exquisitely minimal instrument design. Ivory background throughout. Small left-aligned Qibla title, location row immediately below. Main content is a large precision circular dial floating directly on the page, not inside a rounded rectangular card. Very fine gray minute marks with longer emerald major ticks, one elegant mint alignment sector at the top, a small highly detailed 3D Kaaba just above the top of the dial. An emerald needle anchored on a small central polished hub points 52 degrees right of top; subdued dashed alignment ray extends vertically toward the Kaaba. Large clean "52°" within the lower open region of the dial if clear without needle overlap. Generous breathing room, precise linework, no massive drop shadow. Beneath dial left-aligned prominent instruction, then two compact inline angle readings separated by a hairline. A minimal stroke recalibrate button and a tasteful nearby mosque row with small mosque outline icon and chevron; do NOT use more decorative cards. Fresh editorial industrial design, understandable at a glance. Strongly prioritize legibility, rich restrained craftsmanship.

DIRECTION 2: "Emerald sanctuary". Make this substantially different from a plain white circular compass. At the top of this panel an understated eyebrow "MAKKA TOMON". A prominent carefully lit 3D Kaaba sculpture sits above an elegant low-perspective elliptical alignment dial, almost like a finely made physical compass pedestal; no fantasy architecture or landscape. Mint glowing but restrained target notch at top and slender pale-gold/ivory directional needle oriented 52 degrees clockwise from top; very fine etched marks. Central Kaaba remains unobscured by needle. At bottom of the SAME hero panel large clear white "52°" and readable mint instruction "O‘ngga 52° buring". Two small technical readings below. Below panel, two very restrained actions: outlined "Qayta sozlash", and wider native-looking nearby mosque action with mint surface, arrow and "Yaqin masjidlar". Use tactile 3D elegance to connect with Halovat's existing rendered prayer assets. Premium calm, dark green focal area, ample contrast.
